questions.q: What does the video say at the start is “not clickbait”?
o: Serbia loses a whole city every year
questions.e: In the video: "Svake godine Srbija izgubi ceo jedan grad." — every year Serbia loses a whole city.

questions.q: How many children per woman are needed for natural renewal?
questions.e: In the video: "potrebno je da svaka žena rodi 2,1 dete" — every woman needs to give birth to 2.1 children.

questions.q: What example is given about women's rights?
o: Before WWI women were only 10% of students
Women used to be the majority of students
questions.e: In the video: "pre Prvog svetskog rata žene su činile samo 10% studenata Beogradskog univerziteta" — before the First World War women made up only 10% of students at the University of Belgrade.

questions.q: Why were children once “profitable” for parents?
o: They worked from a young age
questions.e: In the video: "deca su neretko bila zaposlena od malih nogu" — children were often employed from a young age.

questions.q: How old is the average person who leaves Serbia?
questions.e: In the video: "prosečna starost osobe koja napusti zemlju samo 29 godina" — the average age of a person who leaves the country is only 29.

questions.q: Which salary does the author consider more realistic to look at?
questions.e: In the video: "medijalnu platu, koja je iznosila oko 94.000 kinti, odnosno 800 evra" — the median salary, which was about 94,000 dinars, that is, 800 euros.

questions.q: What share of GDP do diaspora remittances make up?
questions.e: In the video: "iznose oko 5–8% BDP-a" — amount to about 5–8% of GDP.

questions.q: What is “brain drain”?
questions.e: In the video: "Odliv mozgova je odlazak visokokvalifikovanih, visokoobrazovanih ljudi" — brain drain is the departure of highly qualified, highly educated people.
